title: End Semester Exam Schedule Released
body: The end semester examination timetable for Semester 2 2026 has been officially released. Students are advised to check the academic notice board and plan their preparation accordingly. Any clashes must be reported to the examination office within 3 working days.

title: Library Hours Extended During Exams
body: The CST library will remain open until 10 PM from 20 April to 15 May 2026 to support students during the examination period. Students must carry their college ID at all times.

title: Annual Sports Day 2026
body: The Annual Sports Day will be held on 25 April 2026 at the college sports ground. All students are encouraged to participate. Registration for events closes on 22 April. Contact the Student Affairs office for details.

title: Fee Payment Deadline Reminder
body: Students who have not yet cleared their semester fees are reminded that the deadline is 30 April 2026. A late fee will be applicable after the deadline. Contact the Finance Office for any queries.

title: Industrial Attachment Briefing
body: A mandatory briefing for all Year 3 students regarding the upcoming industrial attachment programme will be held on 23 April 2026 at 2 PM in the Conventional Hall. Attendance is compulsory.

title: Campus Wi-Fi Maintenance
body: The campus Wi-Fi network will undergo scheduled maintenance on 21 April 2026 from 10 PM to 2 AM. Internet services will be unavailable during this period. Plan your work accordingly.

title: Hackathon 2026 - Open Registration
body: CST Hackathon 2026 is open for registration. Teams of 3 to 5 students can register at the IT Club booth or online. The event will be held on 2 May 2026. Theme will be announced on the day.
